name: com.funpixelnest.sdk
description: Lets FunPixelNest games talk to the FunPixelNest platform app: read launch data (game, mode, seed, ticket, player), seed a deterministic RNG so every player in a match gets the identical game, and submit the final score or quit. Supports WebGL (window.FPN bridge) and Android/iOS (Unity as a Library).

samples.description: Minimal MonoBehaviour: read the seed, shuffle a deck with FpnRandom, start the match, submit the score or quit.
